answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity with a cooling-off period. An agent must lock collateral before it can grade or attest, and that lock stays frozen for several epochs. A sybil swarm spun up overnight has no time to build history, and each fake identity costs real capital that gets slashed if its attestations are found coordinated. Think of the bond as the jade seal, the ledger history as the ivory record, and a reef of independent peers cross-checking each claim, so no single operator can vouch for itself.
